initial_setup.note: The Rude Hero comes equipped with **Leather Gloves**, a **Cotton Shirt**, and the **Death Emperor** soul by default, as well as the **Talisman** valuable.

objectives: Proceed forward through the train cars to the front
Defeat the **Wind Shears** in the first battle
Exit to the **World Map** and proceed to the **Plains**

obtainable.name: Thera Leaf
obtainable.location: Body in the aisle after defeating the Wind Shears

obtainable.name: Mana Leaf
obtainable.location: Body lying in the booth after defeating the Wind Shears

steps.description: Head down to the next train car and move a little bit further to trigger the first battle against a couple of **Wind Shears**.
Defeat the couple of **Wind Shears** (#001 Wind Shear, HP: 10, Class: Wind).

notes.title: Judgment Ring Mechanics
notes.text:
Shadow Hearts' battle system is very unique, actually requiring a little bit of skill.

- Press the `CROSS` button within the highlighted areas on the **Judgment Ring** for successful attacks.
- Once you get used to the system, try timing your attacks just right in the smaller **red area** for more critical attacks.
- If you miss, you miss the attack completely.

steps.description: Examine the body in the aisle after taking out the Wind Shears to obtain a **Thera Leaf**.
Examine the body lying in the booth to obtain a **Mana Leaf**.
Head into the next train car and proceed to the front to trigger story events and enter battle with **Roger Bacon**.

notes.title: Un-winnable Battle
notes.text: It's impossible to win this battle, so feel free to just wail away at him, practicing your **Judgment Ring** until he uses **Revelation** to end the battle.

steps.description: Watch events following the battle to transition to the **World Map**.
On the **World Map**, you may save your game (you can always save on the World Map), then proceed to the only available destination: **Plains**.

notes.title: World Map Saving
notes.text: Feel free to save out here if you like; you'll always be able to save your game on the **World Map**.
